subject: Cornerstone: executive walkthrough — gating and recording consent
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha@cornerstone.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: mark.li@cornerstone.com, procurement@cornerstone.com
Date: Sat, 09 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec walkthrough request — Cornerstone pilot intro

Hi Irene and Ben,

Thanks again for the trial access last week — the engineering team had a good first pass. We
would like to book a short executive walkthrough for our CIO and VP of Product to review
integration and security gating. Our goals are:
- Confirm data isolation model and audit log visibility for our compliance team
- See the runbook for the demo day and decide whether recording is acceptable for our legal team
- Align on timeline for a pilot expansion decision (internal deadline: end of June)

Two time windows that work for the execs next week: Tue 5/12 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 5/14 15:00–16:00 PT.
If neither fits on your side, we can widen to the following week.

Also attaching a short questionnaire on technical gating we sent to our security team (cornerstone_risks_questions.pdf).

Best,
Asha Patel
Director, Platform Partnerships
Cornerstone HealthTech

----
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: Asha Patel <asha@cornerstone.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 09 May 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec walkthrough request — Cornerstone pilot intro

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear list of asks and for the questionnaire. Ben, Marissa — looping you both in to confirm exec availability and recording policy.

Asha: we can do either slot but prefer Tue 5/12 10:00 PT (keeps it out of product planning blocks here). Proposed agenda (30–40 mins):
1) 5 min — introductions and pilot objective alignment (Irene + Asha)
2) 15 min — short run-through of integration and data/auth model (Ben)
3) 10 min — gating & audit logs + Q/A (Marissa + security link)
4) 5 min — next steps and decision timeline

On recording: we usually record executive walkthroughs for internal notes and to share with the implementation team. We can mark the recording as internal only and provide a secure download link; if Cornerstone needs further redaction or restricted retention we can agree on a short retention policy. Please confirm your legal team's preference and any PII redaction requirements.

We also have an updated demo runbook (demo-runbook-v2.docx) that I'll attach to the invite.

Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

----
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: internal: Cornerstone executive walkthrough — who should lead which section

Irene / Marissa — quick internal sync before we confirm with Asha. I can cover the integration + latency/cost profile and show the dedicated vs hosted routing that matters for their compliance ask. Marissa, can you own the audit log visibility and retention discussion? Also, legal asked whether we have a standard retention clause we can propose (30 days internal, extendable by contract).

Two questions for you both:
- Executive presence: do we want VP-level product (Marissa) + Solutions (Irene) or add a brief opening by a sales exec? My read: keep it small — product + solutions will do.
- Recording: if they insist on no recordings, we should offer a real-time transcription-only deliverable with a secure ephemeral transcript. Is that feasible for the runbook?

If we stick with Tue 5/12 10:00 PT, I'll prepare a short animation on request routing and fallback examples.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

----
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Asha Patel <asha@cornerstone.com>, irene_choi@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 17:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec walkthrough request — Cornerstone pilot intro

Hi Asha — Tue 5/12 10:00 PT works for us. We appreciate the agenda — I'll be prepared to walk through audit logs, retention options, and the quick checklist for SOC-2 evidence we usually provide.

Recording: Cornerstone can either:
1) Opt-in to an internal recording retained by Redwood for 30 days (default)
2) Request no recording; we'll instead produce a secure transcript and a short technical summary doc that we share via a protected link.

Please confirm which you prefer and whether Mark Li (VP Product) will join — if Mark does attend, we suggest a 45-minute window to leave room for questions.

I'll send a calendar invite shortly with the runbook attached.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Strategy | Redwood Inference
